title: Chinese Are More Generous Than Americans?
synopsis: Have you ever seen Chinese people in a restaurant holding out their money, fighting over who gets the honor of paying the bill? Here we learn more about this phenomenon.

fullText.simplified:
中国人比美国人大方？

    不知道你在中国有没有看到过这样的场景：在饭店的收银台前，两个人都拿着钱或者银行卡，抢着买单？也许你会觉得很奇怪，怎么中国人那么大方，都爱请人吃饭，为什么不AA制呢？
    其实，这不是大方，应该算是一种“中国特色”吧。中国人喜欢礼尚往来，很多人都觉得这次我买单了，下次自然就该轮到他请客了。这样一来一往，一段时间下来，也基本上算是AA制了。当然也有些人觉得不抢着买单会很没面子，别人会认为他很小气。特别是约会的时候，基本上都是男人买单，如果男人让女人买单的话，很多人就会觉得这个男人小气，没用。
    但是现在也有一些年轻人喜欢AA制，他们觉得这样自己想点什么就点什么，不用担心是别人请客，而不敢点贵的东西，比较自由。
fullText.traditional:
中國人比美國人大方？

    不知道你在中國有沒有看到過這樣的場景：在飯店的收銀台前，兩個人都拿著錢或者銀行卡，搶著買單？也許你會覺得很奇怪，怎麼中國人那麼大方，都愛請人吃飯，為什麼不AA制呢？
    其實，這不是大方，應該算是一種“中國特色”吧。中國人喜歡禮尚往來，很多人都覺得這次我買單了，下次自然就該輪到他請客了。這樣一來一往，一段時間下來，也基本上算是AA制了。當然也有些人覺得不搶著買單會很沒面子，別人會認為他很小氣。特別是約會的時候，基本上都是男人買單，如果男人讓女人買單的話，很多人就會覺得這個男人小氣，沒用。
    但是現在也有一些年輕人喜歡AA制，他們覺得這樣自己想點什麼就點什麼，不用擔心是別人請客，而不敢點貴的東西，比較自由。

raw.synopsis: Have you ever seen Chinese people in a restaurant holding out their money, fighting over who gets the honor of paying the bill? Here we learn more about this phenomenon.
sentence_translations: Are Chinese More Generous Than Americans?
I don't know if you've ever encountered this scene in China:
In front of the cashier in a restaurant, two people hold out their money or credit cards and fight over paying the bill.
How come Chinese people are so generous? They all want to pay, why not just split the bill?
Actually this is not being generous, but must instead be seen as a Chinese characteristic.
The Chinese like to exchange favors, and many believe that if I pay this time, then it will be the other person's turn the next time.
After going back and forth like this for a while, it is basically a way of splitting the bill.
Of course, some people also believe that you lose face by not fighting over the bill, and that others will think that you are cheap.
Especially on dates, it is basically always the man who pays.
If a man makes the girl pay for the bill, a lot of people will consider him cheap and useless.
But nowadays some young people also like splitting the bill.
This way they are more free to order what they want, even if it's expensive, and need not worry that someone else is paying the bill.
